description: Remove subscribers from a list by email address. Maximum 500 emails per call. Subscribers stay in the account; only the list membership is removed. Returns the removed count plus a notFound array of emails that did not match a subscriber.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

emails.description: Email addresses to remove from the list. Maximum 500 per call.

listId.description: Subscriber list ID to remove subscribers from.

name: remove_subscribers_from_list

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `remove_subscribers_from_list` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

list.description: The list record returned by Sequenzy.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

removed.description: Number of subscribers removed from the list.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
